name: AkuAuction refund-counter mismatch permanently locks project funds
summary: claimProjectFunds() required refundProgress to reach totalBids, but processRefunds() advanced refundProgress once per bidder entry while totalBids counted auction units. After all 3,669 entries were processed, totalBids remained 5,495, making the project withdrawal condition unreachable and permanently locking the residual auction balance.

loss.notes: The selected final refund batch exhausted every bidder entry and left exactly 11,539.5 ETH in AkuAuction, equal to its present balance. The valuation uses the last DefiLlama ETH observation before that transaction.

ageReset.description: This transaction directly deployed the immutable AkuAuction runtime containing processRefunds() and the unreachable claimProjectFunds() condition.

sources.note: Reviewed every processRefunds() transaction through the selected final batch, contract state, verified source, the commit-pinned reproduction, the deployment transaction, and archive-node runtimes. AkuAuction 0xf42c318dbfbaab0eee040279c6a2588fa01a961d was directly deployed at block 14636831:436 by owner 0xcc0ecd808ce4fed81f0552b3889656b28aa2bae9. Its 6,525-byte runtime hashes to 0x798c8681b76572d14dfa041d337a8e065029a47c1ff1fe358a23c7efe1ba5384 at deployment and immediately before the selected transaction. The selected processRefunds() call exhausted all 3,669 bidder entries, leaving bidIndex and refundProgress at 3,669 while totalBids remained 5,495. An eth_call from the owner to claimProjectFunds() at that state reverts with Refunds not yet processed. The contract balance then and at review time is exactly 11,539.5 ETH. This final state transition is the onchain failure boundary for the permanent lock.

notes: The seed record used the first successful refund batch. This record uses the final batch that exhausts every bidder entry and establishes the irrecoverable counter mismatch onchain.
